wm_eventmatch rejects each modal keymap item by event type: every Knife item is a concrete keyboard/mouse button type; modifier any=True does not make the item event type ANY. Raw PAN val=KM_NOTHING is not a double click.

wm_event_modalkeymap_begin rewrites type to EVT_MODAL_MAP only after an item match; no Knife item matches MOUSEPAN, so subsequent paired PAN remains raw MOUSEPAN and reaches the exact native pass-through branch.

wm_handler_operator_call applies paint cancellation policy only for handler paint serial or explicit owner teardown; ordinary Knife serial0 follows its own modal. PASS_THROUGH alone returns WM_HANDLER_CONTINUE and carries no FINISHED/CANCELLED bit, leaving Knife registered.

wm_event_do_handlers dispatches modal handlers first, then (without BREAK) exposed area/region handlers. Native default viewport keymap selects Ctrl-TRACKPADPAN→view3d.zoom. Native zoom wrapper has no one-finger filter.
